location_review.01-return: Gipath Sands: original coastal Jun ruins and bridges; deliberate sea-facing view, no visible hero.
location_review.02-gipath: Middle Mountains: native green dragon valley; no introduced creature and no visible hero.
location_review.03-ingos: Lake and castle in the original Ingos map; explicitly retained scenic exception.
location_review.04-suslanger: Later Suslanger city map gz18h: irrigation canals and orchards. Not the prison camp or Rindale arrival hub.
location_review.05-astral: Late Jigran map gz35j: Sadrok island bridges, statue and Firez fortress skyline. Native expansion text identifies this as the Hadagan stronghold.
location_review.06-hdlands: Dead City ruined fountain and paving in gz9g. Actual HD Lands 1.5.0 package; credit Atom.
location_review.08-tactical: Original orc, white wolf and witch encounter in Sands, original MOB positions; Gipath shop-1 leather and stone equipment.
location_review.09-first: Native white tiger in Ingos gz11k, NID 3990; iron bow and Kania armour. Track the living opponent with normal direct-control input.
location_review.10-third: Native OgreHadaganF15, NID 150993, outside later Suslanger city gz18h. Zak is free after the prison/catacomb escape; Hadagan steel equipment is available through the Suslanger shop-4 catalogue. gz15h prison footage is rejected.
location_review.11-coop: Two actual network players at the Dead City fountain approach, with Gipath equipment.
location_review.14-touch: Sands bridge encounter area with native touch controls and Gipath equipment.
location_review.15-gamepad: Dead City fountain approach with native pie-section system wheel and Gipath equipment.
location_review.16-play: Late-map establishing view behind the platform/website end card.
location_review.17-rain-tactical: Archived ravine take; excluded from revision 2 because the rock walls dominate the battle composition.
location_review.18-ogre-third: Original later Suslanger ogre; stationary player attack input avoids repeated approach nudges.
location_review.19-ogre-tactical: Archived isometric ogre angle; excluded from revision 2 because palm fronds obscure the action.
location_review.20-tiger-first: Longer native Ingos white tiger encounter, tracked from first-person eyes.
location_review.21-rain-ruins: Later Gipath coastal Jun ruins, native zone rain.
location_review.22-endcard: Later Lost in Astral Sadrok island and fortress.
location_review.23-dead-city: Original Dead City skeletons 2304, 1584 and 1585, retained at their authored positions; player approaches from the open ground east of the ruined fountain. Native rain, HD Lands, Gipath leather/stone wardrobe, and a player-craftable fireball with effect/stamina runes.
location_review.24-dragon-valley: Original Middle Mountains dragonkin 1434/1435 and flying green dragon 1436; player remains on the valley path, with the camera raised to include the dragon above the ruins. Native actor statistics and Gipath equipment/spell components.
location_review.26-lava-first: Rejected from the final edit: the tunnel camera obscured the setting; the earlier source is retained only for reference.
location_review.27-orcs-first: Original orc camp by the Big Lake, gz7g, NID 5226. West-side player approach keeps the lake, bridge and original ogre behind the melee; Gipath leather and granite sword.
location_review.28-banshee-first: Two Rivers, Lost in Astral gz34j: native banshee fighter NID 44453163 beside the river. Kania steel kit, actual first-person sword swings and native banshee attacks.
location_review.29-troll-third: Original Ingos blue troll, NID 4043, approached from the east along the snow path. Kania iron and blue-troll-hide kit. The alternative south-facing angle was rejected because its foreground cliff blocks the view.
location_review.30-portal-third: The guarded Portal, later Suslanger map gz19h (not prison gz15h). Original gate guards 997003 and 997007, player approaches from the northeast; the gate towers and courtyard frame the duel. Hadagan steel equipment fits the free, later-campaign Zak.
location_review.31-fortress-third: Dar-Ulgorn fortress, native guard 44453161 beside the canal bridge. The east bank approach at 201.25,99.25 has a clear camera, visible bridge and reflections, and a native walkable path. A continuous one-second forward input precedes combat; offline capture keeps the normal input watchdog alive. West approaches were rejected for bridge-post, roof and shrub obstructions.
location_review.25-touch-city: Native touch menu in the Dead City, with Gipath equipment.
location_review.32-dragon-first: Island of Death, Lost in Astral gz32j: native red dragon 44432950 flying over the sea beside the island bridge. Player stands on the island road at the bridge landing, with Kania steel and a long crossbow. The offshore blue-dragon angle was rejected.
